topics.question_text: What role should government play in healthcare access?

stances.text: Make healthcare free and available to everyone, fully paid for by the public sector
Make sure everyone has affordable coverage through a mix of public programs and regulated private insurance
Help people who can't afford care and expand programs for seniors and low-income residents, while keeping private insurance for everyone else
Only help the poorest people afford healthcare and leave everyone else to employers and private insurance
Stay out of healthcare entirely and let private markets handle all coverage decisions
